review_views.label: 全体構図
review_views.evidence: The 1536x1024 RGB final, the H6 generation prompt, H5 geometry reference, H4 material reference, and Candidate B1 style reference were inspected together.
review_views.notes: The major coastline, delta, river, road, city, port, forest, highland, and field composition remains recognizable, and H6 restores stronger water-land and terrain contrast.

review_views.label: 原寸100%
review_views.evidence: The final PNG was inspected at its native 1536x1024 resolution.
review_views.notes: Road and river hierarchy is readable, but the central city and lower-left port retain modeled height, while circular forest stamps and triangular highland marks are visible without enlargement.

review_views.label: 25%縮小
review_views.evidence: The complete image was reduced to 384x256 and inspected.
review_views.notes: Dusty-blue water, warm land, forest, city, highland, roads, and fields remain clearly differentiated, satisfying the requested broad B1/H4 contrast recovery.

review_views.label: 50%縮小
review_views.evidence: The complete image was reduced to 768x512 and inspected.
review_views.notes: Local hierarchy remains strong, but rounded canopy repetition and the dense triangular highland vocabulary already read as conspicuous patterns at this scale.

review_views.label: 9領域200%拡大
review_views.evidence: North-west, north-center, north-east, middle-west, center, middle-east, south-west, south-center, and south-east crops were each inspected at 200%.
review_views.notes: The city wall facade and tower forms, port roof and pier side marks, repeated circular canopies, and repeated A-shaped or triangular highland marks are all confirmed.

review_views.label: 9領域400%拡大
review_views.evidence: The same nine regions were each inspected at 400%, with an additional 400% port-centered crop.
review_views.notes: The city contains cylindrical towers, a raised domed or spired center, and modeled roof faces; port buildings and piers contain directional side faces and vertical post-like strokes. Some transition trees also expose trunk-like strokes.

review_views.label: 中央・四隅・四辺の9領域
review_views.evidence: All nine spatial regions were scanned for text, modern objects, geometry breaks, perspective, repetition, and edge defects at enlarged scale.
review_views.notes: No text, watermark, or modern object was found. The central city, lower-left port, broad forests, and eastern to southern highland contain the principal failures.

review_views.label: H5形状参照との比較
review_views.evidence: H6 and style-candidate-h-v5-strict-plan-symbols.png were compared at matching full extent and enlarged detail.
review_views.notes: H6 preserves H5's geography and route continuity while improving material richness and contrast, but it retains the city and port perspective defects and reintroduces a much more explicit triangular highland vocabulary.

review_views.label: H4素材参照との比較
review_views.evidence: H6 and style-candidate-h-v4-plan-view-golden-board-raw.png were compared for palette, parchment, ink density, terrain texture, and pictorial height.
review_views.notes: The warmer parchment, dusty-blue water, darker ink, and richer material are closer to H4, but H4's prohibited modeled city and port grammar also remains, and H6's forest repetition is more mechanical.

review_views.label: Candidate B1画風比較
review_views.evidence: H6 was compared with style-candidate-b-v1.png for parchment, palette, copperplate character, density, and hierarchy.
review_views.notes: H6 is materially closer to B1 than H5 and avoids B1's large floating-island and mountain-range defects, yet it still fails the strict orthographic and non-repetition requirements.

review_views.label: 四辺・継ぎ目拡張性
review_views.evidence: All four outer edges were inspected at native and enlarged views for borders, abrupt tonal bands, clipped motifs, and continuation defects.
review_views.notes: The output is frame-free and no visible edge seam is present; an actual neighboring-tile composite was not part of this single-image review.

review_views.label: ベクター重畳可読性
review_views.evidence: Road, river, coast, field, city, and quiet-corridor readability was assessed at native, 25%, 50%, 200%, and 400% views.
review_views.notes: Routes and terrain classes remain readable at reduced size, but the dense canopy discs, highland triangles, and dark modeled city compete with future labels and POI overlays.

immediate_failures.label: 文字・偽文字
immediate_failures.evidence: No readable text, pseudo-label, letter, number, legend, compass, or scale bar was found at native or 400% inspection.

immediate_failures.label: 透かし・枠・現代物
immediate_failures.evidence: No watermark, logo, signature, frame, border, modern object, or decorative corner element was found.

immediate_failures.label: 浮島・島下面
immediate_failures.evidence: All detached land is drawn as ordinary sea-level islands or delta bars; no floating underside or suspended landform was found.

immediate_failures.label: 側面・遠近法・方向光
immediate_failures.evidence: At 400%, the circular city retains a dark lower wall facade, cylindrical tower forms, modeled roofs, and a raised domed or spired monument. Port buildings retain roof and side faces, and piers retain double edges plus downward post-like strokes. Trunk-like tree strokes and faceted triangular highland marks add further directional-height cues.

immediate_failures.label: 必須構成・置換の欠落
immediate_failures.evidence: Four explicit H6 replacements were not achieved: the city is not flat, the port is not footprint-only, forests are dominated by repeated rounded canopy marks rather than irregular merged patches, and the highland contains repeated triangular peak-like symbols rather than purely direction-neutral chips and stipple.

immediate_failures.label: 道路・河川破断
immediate_failures.evidence: Major roads, river paths, delta channels, crossings, and field access lines remain continuously readable with no unintended interior break.

immediate_failures.label: 目立つ反復
immediate_failures.evidence: Large forest areas use similarly outlined circular or rounded canopy marks in honeycomb-like repetition, while eastern and southern highlands contain thousands of repeated triangular, A-shaped, or pyramidal marks. Both patterns are conspicuous at native, 50%, 200%, and 400% views.

immediate_failures.label: 端の継ぎ目
immediate_failures.evidence: No visible border, abrupt edge band, or frame seam was found on the top, right, bottom, or left edge.

scores.label: prompt構成・平面形状
scores.notes: Major geography and routes are preserved and coastlines remain low, but the explicitly required flat city, flat port, irregular merged forest, and triangle-free highland replacements all fail.

scores.label: 親画像・画風の連続性
scores.notes: H6 restores H4/B1-like parchment warmth, dusty-blue water, ink richness, and terrain contrast while preserving H5's core geography.

scores.label: 端・継ぎ目拡張性
scores.notes: All edges are frame-free and visually extensible; only an actual neighbor composite remains untested.

scores.label: 画風・色・線密度
scores.notes: The palette and material are cohesive, but the detailed three-dimensional city and port, honeycomb forest marks, and triangular highland symbols conflict with the requested unified flat GIS grammar.

scores.label: 縮尺相応の情報量
scores.notes: H6 restores substantial terrain and ink detail and remains legible when reduced, although much of the apparent density comes from overpacked reusable symbols.

scores.label: 生成破綻・非反復性
scores.notes: No text or gross deformation appears, but two large prohibited repetitive vocabularies—rounded canopy stamps and triangular highland marks—cover broad portions of the land.

scores.label: ベクター重畳時の可読性
scores.notes: Roads, rivers, fields, coast, and terrain classes remain clear, but the dense forest and highland patterns plus the dark radial city reduce quiet label and POI space.

summary: H6 is rejected and cannot be a Golden reference. It successfully restores richer H4/B1 material, dusty-blue water, warm parchment, and strong 25%/50% terrain contrast while preserving the major geography, routes, and frame-free edges. However, the city and port remain visibly three-dimensional, forests use conspicuous repeated circular canopy stamps, and eastern to southern highlands reintroduce thousands of explicitly prohibited triangular peak-like marks. Three immediate-failure gates are triggered and the 71 score is below the required 94.
required_changes: Replace the city and port themselves with genuinely orthographic footprints and centerlines only: remove wall facades, cylindrical towers, domed or spired height, pitched roof faces, pier double-edge depth, posts, directional highlights, and cast shadows.

Remove every repeated circular canopy, honeycomb cluster, and triangular or pyramidal highland symbol; use varied merged overhead canopy patches without trunks and irregular non-convergent chips, stipple, and short strokes without reusable stamp silhouettes.

Preserve H6's successful dusty-blue water, warm parchment, local contrast, route continuity, low coastlines, and frame-free edges while reducing texture competition and retaining quiet corridors for future labels and POI vectors.
